resource.name: email-intake
resource.description: Inbound mailbox capture: retrieves incoming email correspondence from a Gmail mailbox an Admin configures, either one organization-wide default or a separate mailbox per department. A different provider may be adopted later — the department's mailbox address stays app data either way.

config.description: Google service-account JSON key with domain-wide delegation enabled in the Workspace admin console, used to impersonate each configured mailbox when polling for new mail.
The Google Workspace domain the service account is authorized to impersonate accounts within, e.g. example.gov.
